statement.p: Find all vectors \vec v in 2 dimensions having ||\vec v|| = 41 where the \,\mathit{\vec i}-component of \vec v is 9 \,\mathit{\vec i}.

p.em: (If you find more than one vector, enter them in a comma-separated list.)

static.solution: \vec v in the \,\mathit{\vec i}-direction is 9, we have \vec v = 9 \,\mathit{\vec i} + b \,\mathit{\vec j} for some b. Since ||\vec v|| = 41, we have \sqrt{9^2 + b^2} = 41^2, so b = 40 or b = -40. There are two vectors satisfying the properties given: \vec v = 9\,\mathit{\vec i}+40\,\mathit{\vec j}, 9\,\mathit{\vec i}-40\,\mathit{\vec j}.
